mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.05 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPI) exceeds 275, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL > 275.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and high housing starts (HOUST > 1500) signals an overheating economy that may prompt aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE < 4.0 and HOUST > 1500.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rising federal funds rate compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.1 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts (HOUST) over the past month signals strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST rises by at least 50 units.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 99.5, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and industrial activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO < 99.5.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0), low unemployment signals strong wage growth and potential inflation, which may lead to aggressive monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 275) and high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) signals an economy facing stagflation, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL > 275 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.
